name: Ordinero Business
subtitle: The Ordinero Business iPhone app
description: Add this source to install Ordinero Business and get its updates.

apps.name: Ordinero Business
apps.subtitle: Your restaurant tonight
apps.localizedDescription: Tonight’s tables, bills and menu for Ordinero restaurant owners.
apps.versionDescription:
A new look.

- Sign in: a new welcome page with the raccoon, email sign-in on a page of its own, and a cheer when you're in.
- Overview: "Tonight" at the top, with the week, today's takings against a typical day, open orders and tables in use.
- Tables: every table in a list showing where it is in its visit, with the bills that are waiting first. Settle a table
  by card or cash from its sheet.
- The app asks you to install a new version as soon as one is out.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ordinero uses the camera to scan the sign-in code on your dashboard, to take photos for your menu and to map your room for the table finder.
